name: Thymalin
description: Mix of peptides (up to 10 kDa) extracted from calf thymus glands

note.text: Nearly all studies come from one St. Petersburg group, many in Russian, and have not been repeated by independent researchers.

bullets: **Calf-thymus extract,** a mix of peptides rather than one defined molecule
**Dipeptides KE and EW** named as active parts by the developers
**Raised CD28,** a mature T-cell marker, in human stem cells in the lab
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.soldAs: “Research use only” (not for human use) in the US
practical.monitored: Immune cells, IL-6, CRP, D-dimer, lung scans

regulatory.text: Not approved; not on compounding lists
Not named; S0 status depends on approval

references: Stem Cell Rev Rep, thymalin in COVID-19, Feb 2021
Neuro Endocrinol Lett, thymalin and epithalamin in older people, Jun 2003
